choices.B: Right ventricular compliance ลด/เพิ่ม (ไม่มั่นใจว่าลด/เพิ่ม)
choices.D: Increase Left to right shunt causing pulmonary overcirculation

questions.explanation: Large VSD → L→R shunt → pulmonary overcirculation
